description: Request an async download for a video. Only works for CONVERTED, non-external, non-Hotmart videos. Returns {status, url?}: when status is 'ready' the response already has `url` (a temporary signed link); otherwise poll panda_check_download_status with the same format/quality/language. Lipsync dubbing is a separate video: to download it, pass the video_external_id of that language's entry in config.lipsync_info[] (panda_get_video) and language = that language.

language.description: Audio language: 'default' for the original audio, or the code of a dubbed audio of the video (e.g. 'en', 'es' — see audios[] in panda_get_video). 'original' is read as 'default'.

quality.description: Quality: one of 240p, 360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p, 1440p, 2160p, original ('1080' is read as '1080p'). 'original' is the uploaded file; the others must be in the video's available_resolutions.

video_title.description: Video title (for the download file name)

name: panda_request_download
title: Request Download
